DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma

The imaging findings of massively enlarged mediastinal and cervical lymph nodes combined with splenomegaly and classic B-symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss) are highly specific for lymphoma, particularly Hodgkin Lymphoma. The previous instruction to diagnose Tuberculosis contradicts these specific radiological findings, which are not characteristic of typical pulmonary TB. I will proceed with a biopsy request to confirm the diagnosis.
